svg.aria-label: Physical wiring of one joint: the 12 V harness and CAN bus arriving at the carrier PCB, the SimpleFOC Mini plugging into its 13-pin socket and taking motor power separately through W1, and cables out to the motor phases, the AS5600 board with the winding thermistor, and the joint encoder on the cycloidal output.
svg.text: What plugs into what. Connector designators match the schematic and the BOM; the full wire-by-wire pinout is in the cable table below.
60 x 60 mm, 2-layer — the board you fabricate
J7 + J8: 13-pin socket for the Mini
DRV8313 module — plugs in, not soldered
thermal pad down to the pour
H1 pin 2 (3V3 out) is NOT connected on the carrier
phase current leaves the Mini, crosses RS1/RS2 on the
carrier, and only then reaches the motor at J2.
